elections.baseline_information_limit: Historical election results through 2011 only; no 2016 result or post-election information.
Historical election results through 2016 only; no 2021 result or post-election information.

publication_time_rule: The original publication time must be at or before the cutoff. Retrieval after the cutoff is permitted only to recover a provably pre-cutoff artifact.
unknown_time_rule: If original publication time or version cannot be established, the fact is not admitted.
same_day_rule: Election-day publications are post-cutoff and excluded, even if voting had not yet closed.
later_biography_rule: A later biography may not be used to backfill what was knowable before the election unless it reproduces a dated pre-cutoff official record that is independently archived.
